project_type: Python Flask web application - UAV crack detection dashboard with YOLO11-seg model
build_system: pip with requirements.txt, Dockerfile for containerized builds
test_framework: No formal test suite exists. Validation is via running the app and checking /health endpoint.
build_command: pip install -r requirements.txt (plus fpdf2 openpyxl Pillow for new features)
test_command: python -c "from app import app; client = app.test_client(); r = client.get('/health'); assert r.status_code == 200, r.data"
verification_instructions: 1. Activate venv. 2. Install dependencies. 3. Run python -c import checks for all modules. 4. Run Flask test client against /health endpoint. 5. Verify Docker builds successfully.
setup_instructions: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu -q && pip install -r requirements.txt -q && pip install fpdf2 openpyxl Pillow -q
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. dnf install -y mesa-libGL already done. No GPU available - CPU-only inference. No actual camera hardware - testing is via code import/endpoint checks.
contribution_requirements: Branch: feature/crack-detection-webapp. Preserve existing UI/UX, navigation, styling. Do not redesign. Integration-only enhancements.
key_patterns: - detector.py: background thread with _run() loop, reads frames, runs inference, stores JPEG + status. - capture_manager.py: state machine (monitoring->threshold_reached->capturing->analyzing->analysis_complete->cooldown), saves to captures/ directory. - inference_core.py: annotate_frame() returns (annotated_frame, crack_present, crack_metadata_list). Uses _MODEL_LOCK for thread safety. - app.py: Flask routes, Detector instance created at module level. - dashboard.js: polls /status every 1s, /capture/status every 1.5s. - templates use Jinja2 with url_for() for static assets.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (Flask entry), detector.py (background worker), capture_manager.py (state machine), inference_core.py (YOLO inference), video_source.py (camera abstraction), letsview_source.py (Windows screen capture). templates/ has dashboard.html. static/ has style.css, js/dashboard.js, img/ (SVGs), sounds/ (alert.wav). captures/ is .gitignored output directory.
